# `assets/LicenseTracker.js`

> **Source:** `engine/assets/LicenseTracker.js`

engine/assets/LicenseTracker.js — license metadata + import gate (spec §21).  License metadata is mandatory before import. Marketplace assets are licensed, not sold, and portability varies. The hard rules: only import assets the user owns or is licensed to use; never rip copyrighted game assets; never bypass DRM; store license metadata; warn on unknown/restricted licenses. This gate is advisory by default (warn) and can be set strict (block) per project.
